title: Nigerian-American Teen Accepted to All 8 Ivy League Schools
main_content:
For the second time in two years, all eight Ivy League schools have offered admission to a teenager from Nigeria.

Augusta Uwamanzu-Nna is in her final year at Elmont High School in Long Island, New York. She is at the top of their game, academically. Few Americans are able to get accepted into every one of the Ivy League schools.

Those are Brown University, Columbia University, Cornell University, Dartmouth College, Harvard University, the University of Pennsylvania, Princeton University and Yale University.

In addition, the teenager was accepted at four other schools in the United States. They are Johns Hopkins University, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, New York University, and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.

She [Augusta Uwamanzu-Nna] was a finalist in the 2016 Intel Science Talent Search.

Uwamanzu-Nna has yet to make a decision on what school she will attend.

questions.question: What is special about Augusta Uwamanzu-Nna being accepted to all the Ivy League schools?
options: Few Americans are able to get accepted into every one of the Ivy League schools
She is the first Nigerian ever to achieve this
Only elite athletes typically receive this honor
She was accepted by only one Ivy League school
questions.answer: Few Americans are able to get accepted into every one of the Ivy League schools

questions.question: Has Augusta Uwamanzu-Nna decided what school to attend?
options: Yes, she has chosen Harvard University
No, she has yet to make a decision
Yes, she plans to attend Princeton University
No, she is waiting for scholarship offers
questions.answer: No, she has yet to make a decision
